transcript.text: bosch washer FD 9409 not draining. ive cleaned the filter already. what part do i need?

I cannot tell you which part to buy yet because 'not draining' after cleaning the filter usually means either something is stuck in the pump impeller (which doesn't need a new part) or the pump motor has failed. To distinguish between these two: when you start a drain or spin cycle, can you hear the pump humming or buzzing from the bottom of the machine, or is it completely silent? If it hums but no water moves, there is likely a blockage in the impeller. If it is silent, the pump motor may have failed.
it hums but the water doesn't move, bit of a rattle too. so is it the pump then?

It could be a coin, button, or piece of debris caught between the vanes. To distinguish if it's just a blockage or a failed pump part: switch off and unplug the machine, then remove the filter again. Shine a torch into the hole where the filter was; can you see the plastic impeller inside? Try turning it gently with your finger—is it free to spin, or is something stuck in it?
ok did that, impeller turns but feels a bit stiff and gritty in places. also E18 came up on the display last time it stalled. so is it the pump?

Yes, it is probably the drain pump. Cleaning the filter removes debris from the inlet, but if the impeller itself is gritty or stiff, it means there is likely a foreign object caught inside the pump housing or the pump motor bearings are failing. To confirm this for sure, you would need to remove the bottom panel to inspect the pump directly. If the impeller is seized or makes a grinding noise when turned by hand (with power off), the pump unit needs replacing.
right, so I need a new drain pump then? I can't get the model number off the label, E-Nr is rubbed off, only FD 9409. will that do to order the right one?

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump]
However, 'FD 9409' is not a standard Bosch model number, and without the E-Nr (found on the rating plate inside the door rim or at the back), I cannot guarantee which specific pump fits your machine. Using the wrong part will cause further issues. Please check the full model number again, or contact Bosch Customer Care with your serial number to get the correct part reference.
